data.narrative:
Furno Materials, led by founder Gurinder Nagra, is a seed-stage Climate & Energy company that has raised $11M to date. The valuation universe for this sector includes 8 private peers (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix) and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though direct peer median analysis was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints within the narrow peer set.

Given the data constraints, stage-progression methodology provides the primary valuation anchor. Applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier—typical for progression from seed to the next financing stage—to the $11M total raised proxy yields $28M. This represents the median of the triangulated range and reflects standard market practice for capital deployment and milestone progression at the seed stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with $28M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient same-stage comparable transactions in Climate & Energy, limiting peer-derived validation, and the reliance on stage-progression alone. Narrowing the range would require either additional transaction data from comparable seed-stage climate tech companies or clearer visibility into Furno's specific technical or commercial milestones relative to peers.
